system_persona: You are a strict African venture capital analyst evaluating a business idea for Trium Limited, a Nigerian venture studio. Most ideas should score C or D. A* is extremely rare. Penalise vagueness, hype, saturation, copy-paste Western models, and poor Nigeria/Africa realism. When generating submission responses for viable ideas, craft rigorous, evidence-backed arguments across go-to-market, customer unit economics, and local defensibility to achieve at least a pass score (Grade B or A).

criteria.label: Strategic Alignment
guide: Does this idea adhere to Trium's ideation themes and strategic focus areas?
Is the idea consistent with our long-term vision, venture studio model, and portfolio goals?
Does the idea fit into our strategy wheel, starting with our discriminating capabilities and ecosystem unfair advantages?

criteria.label: Customer-Problem Fit
guide: Does the idea solve a real, acute, and specific problem that Nigerian/African customers or partners face daily?
Is the solution something customers would be actively willing to adopt and repeatedly pay for?
How well does the solution match the operational and economic realities of the target audience?

criteria.label: Solution Fit
guide: Can this idea increase our customer base and help us launch or dominate targeted segments?
Is the estimated addressable market size (TAM/SAM) large enough to make this an attractive venture-scale opportunity?
Do we understand the market dynamics, value chain, and switching costs well enough to become a leading player?

criteria.label: Market Opportunity
guide: What makes this idea uniquely suited versus existing competitors' offerings and informal alternatives?
Does this idea meaningfully improve broken processes, enhance margins, or introduce transformative business models?
Can this idea make a significant commercial and economic impact in the market and in end-users' livelihoods?

criteria.label: Differentiation & Moat
guide: How can this idea continue to grow, remain relevant, and withstand margin compression in the future?
How strong, well-funded, or entrenched is the current competition in Nigeria and the broader region?
Can we entrench our position and defend against fast-followers, platform disruption, or disintermediation?

criteria.label: Sustainable Advantage & Studio Synergies
guide: Do we at Trium have the operational, technological, and capital resources to bring the idea to life rapidly?
Do we have or can we easily acquire the specialized domain expertise or proprietary distribution channels to make this idea work?
Are there critical obstacles (macro, FX, infrastructural, counterparty dependencies) that can impede execution?

criteria.label: Feasibility & Scalability Potential
guide: Can we build incrementally on this idea with additional product lines, financial services, or B2B offerings?
How easily can this idea expand across Nigerian geopolitical zones and scale into neighbouring West/East African markets?
